Q: Maven build errors for java app referencing org.controlsfx A:

JavaFX runtime components are missing, you are didn't include them on the modulepath. Use the following comand to point to your JavaFX component library location:

--module-path "/path/to/javafx-sdk/lib" --add-modules javafx.controls,javafx.fxml

Q: Confussed on how to rewrite the path with Traefikv2 A:

I think the redirection model you can try is: incoming host dash.domain.com

forward requests to the InterSystems server at internal.domain.com:57772 (or 192.168.170.16:57772)

Preserve the InterSystems path structure under /csp/obj/...

It you want the outside URL root/to open that dashboard page, use your proxy to map / to /csp/obj/cpocdashboard.csp

If the page loads additional resources under the same app, those paths must be forwarded correctly, not just the single initail page.

In other words, proxying directly to http://192.168.170.16:57772/csp/obj/cpocdashboard.csp

as the only backend target may be the wrong model for an interactive CSP app, because the application may need additional requests under related paths not just that one page.

Q: WP cron job is not triggering a custom plugin A:

This looks like something I've hit before with WP-Cron. I had an API pull that was paginated pulling with WP-Cron at fast intervals and sometimes that would drop out. I know if you're on shared hosting, you may not have a choice for a cron other than WP-Cron.

A few things you can try:

  • Make sure that you have traffic going to your site even your test site since WP-Cron firing is dependent on traffic.

  • I wrote a plugin that would double check that the WP-Cron was still in place in case it dropped out and that solved my issue.
